projection.statement: Assess technical soundness and meaningful contribution, grounding the recommendation in a detailed account of strengths and weaknesses.
Balance novelty, potential impact, and empirical performance; failure to exceed state of the art is not by itself a rejection reason.
Do not let an easily corrected minor flaw become a rejection reason.

sections.extracted_fact: CVPR asks reviewers to assess soundness and contribution, balance novelty, potential impact and performance, and avoid rejecting for easily corrected minor flaws.

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Mindful > soundness
verbatim_excerpts.text: technically sound and make a contribution to the field

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Detailed > main critique
verbatim_excerpts.text: Your main critique of the paper should be written in terms of a list of strengths and weaknesses.

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Detailed > recommendation basis
verbatim_excerpts.text: Your detailed review, more than your score, will help the authors, fellow reviewers, and Area Chairs understand the basis for your recommendation

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Mindful > state of the art
verbatim_excerpts.text: the fact that a proposed method does not exceed the state-of-the-art accuracy on an existing benchmark dataset is not grounds for rejection by itself

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Mindful > balance
verbatim_excerpts.text: weigh both the novelty and potential impact of the work alongside the reported performance

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: How to Write Good Reviews > Be Mindful > minor flaws
verbatim_excerpts.text: Minor flaws that can be easily corrected should not be a reason to reject a paper.
